# Template for .github/scripts/operator_names.local.txt -- copy this file to
# that name and replace the examples below with real identifiers. That file is
# gitignored on purpose: the list of real grid/customer names *is* the
# sensitive data check_operator_data.py exists to keep out of the repo, so it
# can never be the tracked file you're reading right now.
#
# Format: one literal string per line, matched case-insensitively as a whole
# word (regex \b boundaries) against staged diff additions, staged file paths,
# and commit messages. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# No wildcards, no regex syntax -- entries are matched literally.
#
# What belongs here: real grid/site names, customer/operator names, org tags
# (with or without the leading #, both are matched by the bare word), and any
# other real identifier you already know leaked once and don't want to see
# again -- including a real ticket/escalation number, if you know one by
# value. Ticket refs and chat/session ids are *not* pattern-matched (e.g. no
# blanket `OPS-\d+` rule) because most of those in this repo are synthetic
# fixture data and a shape-based rule would flag them constantly -- add a
# specific real one here by value if it ever surfaces.
#
# Examples (fake, safe to leave in the tracked template):
ExampleGridOne
ExampleGridTwo
ExampleCustomerName
ExampleOrgTag
